# Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)

Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate

it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.
## Why it needs a plugin

`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards on

ly a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents

.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the

obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and

the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.
## The seam that works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
`prepareRequest()` (`dsh-

agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every

** step
(`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
share one `opti
ons` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creati

on and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name mus

t be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback f

or a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was
the first implementation's fatal flaw.
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasonin

g_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable p
roviders, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.
## Allowlist

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes o

utside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never re

stricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inherita

cted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported

reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.
## Config
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they mus
t name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).
## Known limits

- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
while the child is

created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
Harness **restart** falls back to the `agen

tOptions` recorded in its
`subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable recor

d and
is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `A

gent`
interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
one-line change; upstre

am, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
`agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (

or to accept `agentOptions` on
the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept exte

rnal PRs
— publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route

that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and

r claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

## Verified live

Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's

| Check | Evidence |
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', rea

-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while

the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` read
s the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.

1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
